teaser.en: The sweet warmth in a coastal pilau or biriani often comes from curls of bark peeled from a tree that grows far away.
teaser.sw: Ladha tamu ya joto katika pilau au biriani ya pwani mara nyingi hutoka kwenye maganda yaliyojikunja ya gome la mti unaoota mbali sana.
teaser.dg: Dzoho-dzoho ya mtswano kpwenye *pilau* au *biriani* ya pwani mara nyinji inalavywa ni vipande vya gopha vinavyodzikundza, vinavyouswa kula muhi unaomera kure.

summary.en: Cinnamon is an imported spice made from dried tree bark. On the coast it flavours pilau, biriani and tea.
summary.sw: Mdalasini ni kiungo kinachoagizwa kutoka nje, kinachotokana na gome la mti lililokaushwa. Pwani hukoleza pilau, biriani na chai.
summary.dg: *Cinnamon* ni chitu cha kupha vyakurya ladha chinachorehwa kula tsi za kondze, chinachohendwa kula gopha ra muhi ririroanikpwa. Pwani nkutiywa *pilau*, *biriani* na chai.

about.en: Cinnamon is the dried inner bark of a tropical evergreen tree in the laurel family. Peeled and dried, the thin bark curls into brown quills or sticks with a sweet, warm scent.
about.sw: Mdalasini ni gome la ndani lililokaushwa la mti wa kitropiki usiopukutika wa familia ya *laurel*. Likishabanduliwa na kukaushwa, gome hilo jembamba hujikunja kuwa vijiti vya kahawia vyenye harufu tamu ya joto.
about.dg: *Cinnamon* ni gopha ra ndani ririroanikpwa ra muhi wenye makodza chila wakati wa tsi za dzoho, wa jamii ya *laurel*. Richiuswa na kuanikpwa, gopha dzembamba rinadzikundza na kukala dza fwimbo ndide za rangi ya dongo, zenye arufu ya mtswano na ya dzoho.

where.en: Cinnamon is imported and bought in markets and shops.
where.sw: Mdalasini huagizwa kutoka nje na kununuliwa sokoni na madukani.
where.dg: *Cinnamon* nkurehwa kula tsi za kondze na nkugulwa cheteni na madukani.

uses.en: It flavours pilau, biriani and tea.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. Swahili calls it *mdalasini*. In English it is cinnamon.
names.sw: Hakuna jina la Kidigo lililorekodiwa bado. Kwa Kiswahili huitwa *mdalasini*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *cinnamon*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo taridzangbweandikpwa. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mdalasini*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *cinnamon*.

reason.en: Another imported spice for pilau and tea
reason.sw: Kiungo kingine kinachoagizwa kutoka nje kwa pilau na chai
reason.dg: *Karafuu*, chitu chanjina chinachorehwa kula kondze kpwa *pilau* na chai

reason.sw: Kiungo kingine kinachoagizwa kutoka nje kwa chai
reason.dg: *Cardamom*, chitu chanjina chinachorehwa kula kondze kpwa chai
